limitations: Validation, not an independent factory/event benchmark. Candidate trained with this source validation split.

reason: Candidate improves fixed validation object precision/recall with no additional negative-image detections. Keep original decoder, confidence and temporal hand/ownership gates. No independent factory/event accuracy claim.
timing_scope: Elapsed per model covers 128 decoded full frames, one NN run and two alternative decoding passes per image, row bookkeeping and final model hash. Excludes session creation. Not end-to-end LIVE latency.
